content.text:
Two wake-ups at 19 months is common but fixable -- the usual move is to stretch his wind-down routine by 10-15 minutes and then respond to night wakes with a brief reassurance (hand on back, no picking up) and a consistent pause before going in, so he learns to resettle himself.

Want the full night-by-night plan for Remy? Reply YES and I'll send it.
